description: This file defines a Console command class 'Serve' for the Daux documentation generator. It configures and executes a local development server to serve documentation via PHP built-in web server, including setup of environment variables and temporary config storage.

classes.name: Serve
classes.description: A command class that extends DauxCommand for serving documentation locally using PHP's built-in server.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, and options for the serve command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Starts the local development server, sets environment variables, and manages temporary configuration files.
